product.name: Regular Fit Twill Shirt
product.description: Regular-fit shirt in soft twill with a comfortable, classic silhouette. Turn-down collar, buttons without placket, and a yoke at back. Long sleeves with sleeve placket, link button, and button at cuffs. Rounded hem.
